text:
Ana Ruiz: Quick async preflight for morning leadflow launch. Need a compact SEO checklist: canonical preference, 5 internal link owners, redirect fallbacks for legacy promo URLs, and a tiny JSON-LD event + FAQ. Can we lock owners now? @Priya @Sam

Priya Patel: I'll own JSON-LD + FAQ and monitor rich results. Example snippet I'll drop into /docs/seo/snippets.

Ethan Cole: I'll run a focused crawl and return top inbound pages to link from. Expect docs/getting-started, integrations, partners, support, pricing.

Sam Wu: Redirect plan: legacy promo paths like /promo/spring23 and partner ?ref variants. Edge strip utm_* then 302 in staging, swap to 301 in prod. Quick nginx test rule: `rewrite ^/promo/spring23/?$ /product/leadflow? redirect;`

Ana Ruiz: Canonical rule: prefer /product/leadflow for the main article. Partner clones should self-canonical only if >30% unique; otherwise rel=canonical -> product URL.

Priya Patel: JSON-LD (short):
`{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Leadflow: routing workshop","startDate":"2026-10-05T17:00:00-07:00","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/leadflow"},"offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":"https://redwood.ai/register/leadflow"}}`
Also adding FAQPage with 3 Qs (register, integrations, change registration). Will A/B collapsed vs inline for 10 days.

Ethan Cole: Anchor suggestions (short):
- docs/getting-started -> "set up inbound lead routing"
- integrations -> "Leadflow integrations"
- partners -> "partner lead routing"
- support -> "routing troubleshooting"
- pricing -> "Leadflow pricing and limits"
I'll add owners in the internal-links sheet.

Sam Wu: CDN note: ensure cache key excludes utm_* and ref params so we don't index duplicates. Will coordinate with infra for middleware param stripping.

Ana Ruiz: Priority checklist for tonight: 1) redirect middleware + 302 smoke (Sam) 2) JSON-LD + FAQ in templates (Priya) 3) internal links + anchors (Ethan) 4) canonical headers on clones (Sam/Ethan) 5) sitemap push + Search Console ping (Ethan). Confirm?

All: confirmed.

Ana Ruiz: I'll run postlaunch checks +2h and +24h. If anything blocks, ping #marketing-urgent. Closing thread.
